connector.name: DeepMap AI
connector.registryDescription: Multi-hazard geophysical risk scoring, prediction, weather, insurance, and climate tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package deepmap-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.deepmapai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: DeepMap AI API key. Get a free key at https://www.deepmapai.com/api/v1/auth/register
